text:
I’m a normal 30yo guy. Writing reviews for fast food spots or any spots for that matter isn’t my deal. But…this is different. This is one of the most poorly run fast food locations I have ever been to in my life.

It’s baffling just how incompetent the people who work here are. They have this system where one person floats up front asking for Uber Eats / Doordash numbers. They also have to cashier. What ends of happing every…single…time is a crowd forms at both the counter and cashier line. Everyone is pissed and at least one group is neglected. I’ve seen people wait in line for minutes on end with not a single word said to them. Mainly because the person floating is a young kid who doesn’t have the best social : professional skills. They just blankly look at people and ask for numbers. It ticks me off so much which is alarming because nothing bothers me.

And this location is notorious for forgetting food items. On my last visit I ordered four items. One item was missing so I asked for it. 20 mins went by before I got it. I asked if I could have me entire order remade obviously. Management came out with bug eyes like I was the crazy one. My “new” food came out but it was the same cold food but this time another item was missing! I waited 10 minutes for this item. I asked if I could have my order remade. 10 minutes go by. When I tell you another item was missing along with all my sauces I wanted to go in the back and make my food myself.

What is going on in the back. The manager at this place needs to seriously lock in and figure something out. I’m a Senior Full Stack Developer. I have to manage and maintain architecture for massive corporations. We’re talking milllions of dollars on the line. 24 developers under me. It’s like dude….this is a Mcdonalds. Make sure the people who were hired to make food read their tickets. Revamp your Uber Eats / Doordash / Cashier mess up front.

There should be a person superglued to the front who is professional and likeable. It’s a barren wasteland upfront as is. The lack of anyone being upfront makes your blood boil. You can feel the anxiety from people waiting upfront. You go to Chick Fil A and the staff are so nice. They have people in their designated spots who are extremely competent. I never have to check my food there because they know how to manage and hire kids. I’m never going to this Mcdonald’s ever again. It is a blight on downtown San Diego.

This is all the managers fault 1000%

I would be so embarrassed to go to work to do the absolute worst job day in and day out. Having worked in the food industry, I’m very compassionate towards everyone who decides to do this type of work. But it’s places like these that make you want to bash on these people. It’s like oh yeah, whoever’s in the back dropping fries…I wouldn’t trust them with a damn thing. I’m convinced everyone who works at this location has the mind of a ladybug. Absolutely nothing going on in the frontal cortex.
author: Joshua Tillman

text: This has got to be by far the worst McDonald's I've ever been to. The staff here are very rude, especially the manager. I stopped by this location because my father who eats there quite often, was there, and went to say "Hi". My father told me it was ok to bring my ebike inside, because he had personally seen people bring in their bikes, and never once has the manager said anything to anyone. He also said he's witnessed homeless people bring their dogs in the restaurant and they be laying on the tables! Gross! This restaurant allows homeless people to bathe and hang out all day. Anyway, the manager approached me, telling me to take my bike from in front of the door, which i did, since it was in the doorway. I moved to where it was not interfering with anyone, and she still had a problem. Now several customers are saying she NEVER  said that to anyone. By now my order was being prepared. I told her I'm waiting on my order, and she tells her staff to never take my order again. She claimed it was a store rule. So why did they take my order in the first place? After she said that, I took out my phone and began recording. Two customers entered with bikes. A homeless lady with a stroller full of stuff parked it in the same doorway my bike was at, and no one said a word. Both customers that brought in bikes were not harassed either. Then another homeless guy entered with a dirty dog, I watched employees walk past and not say a word! Even though there is a sign saying pets not allowed. The manager,  Anastasia, is HORRIBLE, and she obviously trained her staff, because they are just as horrible! If I could give ZERO stars, I would! Throw the whole restaurant away!
author: Tee Petty

text:
Dear McDonald’s Management,

I have always appreciated your chain for its standards of service and the speed of order fulfillment. However, my recent visit on December 29, 2024, at 11:05 AM to your location at [insert address here] left me deeply disappointed.

Despite the promise of quick service, I had to wait over 20 minutes for my order. For a fast-food restaurant, this is unacceptable, as it undermines the core concept of “fast food,” which is fundamental to your brand.

Furthermore, I witnessed a situation that caused even greater concern. Some employees appeared distracted from their duties and were feeding homeless individuals instead of focusing on customer service. While assisting those in need is commendable, such behavior during peak hours in a busy restaurant comes across as unprofessional and negatively impacts the experience for other guests.

I urge you to address the organization of the staff at this location, provide appropriate training to ensure professionalism, and implement measures to maintain your service standards. As your customer, I trust that my concerns will not go unnoticed and that steps will be taken to prevent such incidents from occurring in the future.

I would appreciate your feedback and information on the actions that will be implemented to rectify this situation.
author: Serhii Krus

text: I had very poor service this evening at store 3181 on 1280 Park Blvd, San Diego, Ca 92101. I did a mobile order because it's usually faster and pulled up to the window at 7pm this evening. I was asked to pull forward to the second pickup window at the restaurant. I waited there for 20 minutes. I've knocked on the window and no one answered. I had to leave my car,  with my wife and kids, at the drive thur window and walk in the restaurant. I stood there for another 5 minutes with none of the employees acknowledging that i was there. I had to partially walk in the kitchen to get service. I've asked one of the associates closest to me, where my order was and that I've been waiting at the second pickup window for 20 minutes. He reached around the corner and pulled the happy meal and threw it on the counter and left. The food has been sitting there and is cold. I couldn't get service after that so i just the threw the food away and left. This is the worst experience i ever had. No apologies no nothing. You need to train your employees better customer service, if they don't like working there, they need to be terminated.  You will loose a lot of customers that way.
author: Peter Ma

text:
The location itself is pretty good, but the cleanliness leaves a lot to be desired. The tables and seats are always covered in the last customers' crumbs, so I wouldn't call it clean.
My main issue is with management and the employees, who are frankly incompetent. I ordered for three people (the same order for all three) and the wait time wasn't bad—it was actually fairly good. Just be warned there's no self-serve station for refills outside; you have to ask an employee, though it could be worse.
The real problem was how they called my order. Someone from the kitchen was yelling out order numbers with what sounded like an angry tone. When I went to pick up my order, I couldn't figure out who was calling my number because there was no one at the front counter. Turns out the employee was hiding behind a corner with my order—I couldn't even see her. It was incredibly confusing.
And for a dine-in order, they didn't bring the food to my table, which is also poor service.
The food itself was fine. It's just hard to understand why you'd call out order numbers sounding angry while hiding where customers can't see you.
author: Jesus Hernandez

text: The wait for delivery drivers is too long...at night they make us wait 40mins to 1 hour+ once their lobby closes.  You will see them prioritizing the drive-thru even though they don't understand that delivery drivers are also delivering food orders so they have to go out by a certain time or else they get cold or worse. We get orders canceled and we waste our time. It's just a mess at this McDonald's there's no organization and the managers don't help either. There's only one manager that's good and that's during the daytime but the night manager sucks. Don't expect to get your food quickly. If you're a delivery driver, they treat us like trash. And while I get it, some delivery drivers are really rude. There are some of us that actually do our job really well and our whole job is dependent on time.
author: Olivia Medina

text: Got a toxic tasting burger - called management - did not believe me - wanted me to drive back and let them “smell” it after I reported nasty smell and horrifying taste - unfortunately not able to so it will likely continue because I did not prove it to manager lady. Be careful feeding your kids here! Managers thought I was nuts lol 😷 but I asked 2 other people to smell it - one of which hardly ever can smell anything and they both confirmed something was very off with that burger… 🍔 (one burger was fine [edit to add: well- didn’t let anyone eat the other burger after my first bite but the other one smelled normal anyway]~the other was a disaster in a bun) despite this - there are some old school employees working there for a very long time - some good folks on that crew - nerves of steel there -

text: I got home, put my food on the table and went to eat and realized someone took two bites out of my double quarter punder and then just put it back like nobody would ever notice! I also ordered a six piece mcnugget and there, of course, was only 4. I called the store to let a manager know what was going on and she just kept asking for a receipt number over and over. I informed her it was an order through the app, gave her my drive through code (the app had no receipt #) the time, and exactly what I ordered. She never even said sorry or tried to resolve it. She only said "I can't find your order here in my system". This is the most disgusting, disrespectful, and all around terrible thing that has ever happened to me at a fast food place. What a joke!

text: Horrible experience with this location. I’ve been to this location maybe 4 times and every time they either forget a food item or the sauces. The door dash arrives! And to my surprise (should have expected this) NO SAUCES! NOT A SINGLE ONE! I will never go to this location again. From forgetting sauces to fries and nugget packs, very disappointed. I tried calling the location to let them know, no answer. They did pick up at one point after calling them about 10 times,, just for them to hang it up right away! What a joke.

text: The worst McDonalds in Southern California. Poor attitudes You ask for something and they hide behind the wall because they don’t want to deal with complaints.
